description: Two movers carry a red couch along a front path toward an open truck ramp; a red fox trots through the ramp threshold at their feet as they step onto it; the bystander's handheld phone whips toward the fox in a reflexive reaction, framing loosens and shakes, then partially re-settles as the fox exits frame. Mover 1 walks backward facing Mover 2 the entire shot.
